text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...They've increased. Doesn't seem 
like... a breakdown, though."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Before someone points it out... I have to 
do something about this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Admire Groove had already started 
prepping for training ahead of time.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good work today. We shall begin as 
scheduled—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Um, do you have any announcements? Or 
anything you're concerned about...?
choice_data_list: Huh? No, nothing in particular right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why had she asked such a thing? Admire 
Groove seemed completely normal, but...
